# Usthadian Academy

> Current affairs and educational content covering Indian policy, healthcare, science, agriculture, and technology innovations across multiple languages.

Usthadian Academy provides comprehensive coverage of contemporary developments in India, with focus on state-level initiatives, scientific breakthroughs, and social welfare programs. Content is available in English, Tamil (தமிழ்), and Hindi (हिंदी) to serve diverse audiences preparing for competitive examinations and staying informed about national affairs.

## Key Topics

- India policy and governance
- Tamil Nadu state initiatives
- Healthcare and public health
- Agricultural innovation and IFFCO
- Digital health monitoring (PICME)
- Low birth weight interventions
- Nano fertiliser technology
- Cooperative agriculture
- Medical pioneers and healthcare legacy
- AI-powered education
- Scientific research and discoveries
- Women empowerment in agriculture
- Infrastructure development
- Trade agreements and exports
- Multilingual content (Tamil, Hindi, English)

## Healthcare and Public Health

- [India Expands Preventive Shield with Free HPV Vaccination Drive](https://www.usthadian.com/ta/india-expands-preventive-shield-with-free-hpv-vaccination-drive-ta): India launches free HPV vaccination drive with Gardasil for cervical cancer
- [Tamil Nadu Baby Care Kit Scheme](https://www.usthadian.com/tamil-nadu-baby-care-kit-scheme): Tamil Nadu's Baby Care Kit Scheme addresses low birth weight & infant health
- [Tamil Nadu Baby Care Kit Scheme (Hindi)](https://www.usthadian.com/hi/tamil-nadu-baby-care-kit-scheme-hi): Tamil Nadu Baby Care Kit Scheme targets infant mortality reduction
- [Meghalaya Advisory After Suspected Meningococcal Deaths](https://www.usthadian.com/meghalaya-advisory-after-suspected-meningococcal-deaths): Meghalaya health advisory after meningococcal outbreak at Assam Regt Centre
- [Legacy of Dr K Mathangi Ramakrishnan in Burn Care and Plastic Surgery](https://www.usthadian.com/legacy-of-dr-k-mathangi-ramakrishnan-in-burn-care-and-plastic-surgery): Dr K Mathangi Ramakrishnan's pioneering burn care & collagen innovations

## Agriculture and Rural Development

- [Empowering Women in Agriculture in India](https://www.usthadian.com/ta/empowering-women-in-agriculture-in-india-ta): Women empowerment in Indian agriculture through NRLM & land ownership reforms
